notes: Health: the service registers a tonic_health reporter and serves it on the gRPC server (src/shippingservice/src/main.rs:22-25 set_serving; main.rs:38 add_service(health_service)). No healthcheck is configured for the service in docker-compose.yml:549-573 (no healthcheck key in that block). src/shippingservice/Dockerfile:44-51 installs grpc_health_probe but no HEALTHCHECK instruction appears in the Dockerfile. Container-level health check: library default (no check), not in these files.

Telemetry frequency: the OTLP trace exporter is installed with install_batch(runtime::Tokio) (src/shippingservice/src/telemetry/traces_conf.rs:14-18); no batch or export interval is stated in these files; library default, not in these files.

Telemetry scope: the only OTLP exporter pipeline is traces (traces_conf.rs:14-16). No metrics exporter and no OTLP log exporter appear in src/shippingservice. Logs use simplelog SimpleLogger (src/shippingservice/src/telemetry/logs_conf.rs:6-11) and are not exported over OTLP.

Compose candidate-posture override sets OTEL_SDK_DISABLED, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER and OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER for shippingservice (modules/otel-demo/deployment/compose.candidate-postures.yml:124-130). The shippingservice sources do not read OTEL_SDK_DISABLED or the exporter-selection variables (grep of src/shippingservice finds no reference).

replicas.note: No deploy.replicas or scale key in the shippingservice block at docker-compose.yml:549-573 (or in modules/otel-demo/deployment/compose.candidate-postures.yml:124-130); library default, not in these files (Compose default 1).

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Endpoint is passed to shippingservice at docker-compose.yml:567 as OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://${OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST}:${OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_GRPC} (gRPC port 4317 via .env:28); traces only, see extraction.notes.

syncEdges.note: Synchronous HTTP (reqwest) POST to the quote service's /getquote path (quote.rs:47 and quote.rs:57-60, client.post(quote_service_addr)); the default address is used when QUOTE_SERVICE_ADDR is unset (quote.rs:43-44). Callee name matches the compose service quoteservice (docker-compose.yml:485).
